credit_line: Gift of The Burnett Foundation and The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Large pinkish/orange shell that dominates most of the canvas, with a much smaller shell beside it on the lower left.  Both are oval in shape and open to their undersides, exposing the dark glossy pink of the inside of a shell.  They are nestled on a white cloth or tissue paper that has folds suggesting a depth, as if the objects are in a box.  The larger shell is chipped on it's upper left tip.
